> Linter + security scanner for AI agent skills — paste a SKILL.md, get an A–F grade with evidence-bound findings. 100% local, nothing uploaded.

## Capabilities
- A–F grades with evidence-bound findings
- 6 finding categories (SEC-PI/EX/DE/PR, Q-FM/ST)
- ?scan=<url-to-raw-skill-file> deep links
- Zero-dependency UMD scanner.js (browser + Node)
- Machine-readable findings schema
- 27/27 tests

## How an agent should use this
- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-skill-sentinel/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
